text: Good morning! Are we still trying the new cafe today?
Yes! I can meet you there at ten.
Perfect. I will grab a table by the window.
Thank you. I am bringing the book you lent me.
No rush on the book. See you soon.
See you soon!
That movie was funnier than I expected.
The museum scene made me laugh so hard.
Same. Should we watch the sequel next week?
Absolutely. Tuesday or Thursday works for me.
Let us plan on Thursday.
Thursday it is.
I found the soup recipe we talked about.
Please send it. I need an easy dinner idea.
It takes about thirty minutes and uses one pot.
That is exactly my level of ambition today.
You have got this. Add extra garlic.
Extra garlic is always the answer.
Thanks for helping with the decorations tonight.
Of course. The paper stars turned out great.
I still cannot believe we made twenty of them.
Only nineteen survived the tape incident.
We honor the fallen star.
A true crafting legend.
Want to take a walk after work?
Yes. I have been inside all day.
Let us meet at the north trail at five thirty.
I will bring water and a warm jacket.
Good call. It is colder than it looks.
See you after work.
The bakery still has those lemon cookies.
Please tell me you bought two.
I bought four because I know us.
This is why our friendship works.
I will save yours for tonight.
You are the best.
How did the presentation go?
Better than expected. I was nervous at first.
I knew you would do well.
Your practice questions really helped.
I am glad. You did the hard part.
Thank you for cheering me on.
Do you want to try the farmers market?
Yes. I need flowers and something for lunch.
I vote for the dumpling stand.
Strong vote. Their spicy sauce is excellent.
I will meet you by the entrance at noon.
Deal. I will be there.
That game ending was ridiculous.
I thought we had lost with two minutes left.
The final shot changed everything.
I probably scared my neighbors cheering.
They will understand when they see the replay.
I am already watching it again.
I am sorry I missed your call last night.
No problem. I just wanted your opinion on the trip.
I like the cabin near the lake.
Me too. It has a great porch and enough beds.
Let us book it before the weekend.
I will confirm with everyone today.
What time should I bring the picnic food?
Come by around three. We will eat at four.
I made pasta salad and packed cold drinks.
Amazing. I have fruit and sandwiches.
Looks like we are ready.
See you this afternoon!
